title: My First Project
summary: A modern web application to manage my daily tasks.
description:
This project was designed to simplify daily task management. The goal was to create an intuitive and fast interface for tracking activities.

## Features

- Add and delete tasks
- Organization by categories
- Automatic synchronization
- Responsive interface

## Challenges

One of the main challenges was optimizing performance while maintaining a smooth user experience.
idea: The idea came from seeking a simple solution to organize my daily routine.
